rationale: The agent followed policy: it verified identity using full name plus zip, handled the initial incorrect zip and retried, matched the user to a single account, and only accessed that user’s data. It used read-only tools to retrieve the latest order from the account’s order list and provided the exact paid amount and masked payment method as shown by the tool output. No order-changing actions were taken, so no confirmation was needed. The final information matches the tool results. While the tool did not explicitly label an order as “most recent,” selecting the last/highest order in the list (which is pending) is a reasonable inference from the provided data and is supported by the tool results. Overall, the request was completed correctly and in line with policy.
